purpose: Teach: 画質/長老/竿/無限/分子/頭文字/劇的/ラグビー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのスマホの、本気で、絶対、画質、絶対、よくなったわよ
lines.en: Sho—your sister's phone camera really does take better pictures now, doesn't it?
lines.style: Bright and animated, proud of the observation. Quick delivery, warm eye contact. Playful emphasis on the realization itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、町の、絶対、長老、絶対、みたいだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you sound just like Grandpa talking about town elders or something.
lines.style: Small, genuine observation without judgment. Quiet amusement underneath. Spoken with the matter-of-fact perceptiveness of a kid noticing something adults miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんと、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、釣り、絶対、竿、絶対、で、絶対、川釣り、絶対、行きたいね
lines.en: I'd really love to take you and your dad out fishing sometime—get a rod, go down to the river together.
lines.style: Warm and earnest, eyes bright with the image of it. Spoken as if it's a gift she's already imagining giving. Unhurried, genuine wanting in every word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、無限、絶対、に、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, honestly I'd rather just play video games forever if I could.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact delivery with the smallest smile behind it. The candor of a six-year-old who knows exactly what he wants and doesn't see the point in pretending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、理科で、絶対、分子、絶対、習った?本気で
lines.en: Did you learn about molecules in science class yet, Sho?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, leaning forward slightly. Soft, searching tone—the kind of question that invites him to share something he knows. Not testing, just wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、頭文字、絶対、Sだよ
lines.en: Well, my first name starts with S too, you know.
lines.style: Quick, delighted realization delivered as a small reveal. Animated face, pleased with the connection. The energy of a child proudly claiming membership in a club.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、成長、絶対、劇的、絶対、に、絶対、なったわね
lines.en: You've grown so much, Sho—so much more than I realized.
lines.style: Tender and sincere, almost catching herself in the realization. Spoken softly, with the weight of genuine affection and a little wonder at how much he's changed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ラグビー、絶対、見たことあるよ
lines.en: I've seen you watch rugby before, haven't I?
lines.style: Quick, bright observation delivered with animated pleasure. The energy of recognizing something about him, enjoying the small fact of knowing him well enough to notice.
